Find the shop

1000 Walnut St in Lebanon. The shop opens at 9 AM Monday through Saturday and is closed Sundays.

Hours

Doors open at 9:00 AM, Monday to Saturday. Closing times run later on the shop's busier days and the shop's own listings do not agree on every close, so check the Booksy page or call to confirm the day's last chair. Closed Sundays.
